scripts.build: pnpm build:design && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" build && node scripts/audit-dist.mjs
scripts.build:workloads: pnpm build:design && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" exec vite build --mode workload --outDir dist-workload
scripts.build:workload-tests: pnpm build:design && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" exec vite build --mode workload-test --outDir dist-workload-test
scripts.build:diagnostics: pnpm build:design && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" exec vite build --mode diagnostic --outDir dist-diagnostic
scripts.build:workload-diagnostics: pnpm build:design && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" exec vite build --mode workload-diagnostic --outDir dist-workload-diagnostic
scripts.build:diagnostic-tests: pnpm build:design && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" exec vite build --mode workload-diagnostic-test --outDir dist-diagnostic-test
